comment: Independent C-first gnomish Ranger with DECgraphics and msg_window:combination. Two farlooks of the floor leave lines that open with the DEC room byte 0xFE. The first Ctrl-P (step 16) redraws the current line through topl.c redotoplin() with ttyDisplay->mixed clear, so recorder patch 006 ignores the high first byte and column 0 keeps the blank the --More-- dismissal left; the next ones recall the earlier lines.
